description: 🚀 MayiNautas: Exploring the universe, programming the future. We are a team of four young explorers, aged 11 to 14, accompanied by our teacher, Renzo, and a parent who has joined us on this adventure. We are united by curiosity, creativity, and a desire to discover how technology can help us solve major challenges. This year, inspired by Mayito—our astronaut and programming expert—and his companion, MayiRobit, we aim to take our ideas even further.
